generationMode: one complete native raster per built-in image_gen call
promptAssembly: For each candidate, concatenate sharedPrompts[candidate.sharedPrompt], a newline, and candidate.promptBody. The exact concatenated prompt is copied into the post-generation lineage record.
negativeInventoryRule: For each scene candidate, every family not explicitly represented by an authored target is negative inventory. Any visible unauthored condition in any family rejects the candidate. Zero-hazard controls reject every visible hazard in every family.

sharedPrompts.isolatedTool:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: one alternate-view isolated exam-prep tool-recognition illustration.
Scene/backdrop: visually pure white with no floor plane and no shadow.
Style/medium: original black monochrome technical line illustration; confident medium contour; sparse functional hatching; restrained interior detail; high whitespace; generic unbranded construction; plain civil-service test-booklet visual language. This must be a line drawing, not a photograph, not a shaded 3D render, and not color artwork.
Composition/framing: one complete mechanically plausible subject centered at roughly 72 percent of a square canvas with generous even padding. Nothing may touch or cross the canvas edge.
Color palette: black, white, and restrained neutral-gray line hatching only.
Absolute exclusions: no text or pseudo-text; no labels, arrows, circles, letters, numbers, answer marks, logos, brands, watermarks, hands, people, room, floor plane, props, drop shadow, gray backdrop, decorative border, cropped subject, duplicated components, disconnected or floating parts, or impossible joints.
Output intent: one native raster candidate; do not add explanatory text.
sharedPrompts.hazardScene:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: one original school/custodial hazard-recognition scene for exam preparation.
Style/medium: original black monochrome technical line illustration with confident medium contour, sparse functional hatching, restrained interior detail, generous whitespace, and plain civil-service test-booklet economy. This must be a clean line drawing, not a photograph, not photorealistic, not a shaded 3D render, and not color artwork.
Composition/framing: wide 3:2 landscape scene with complete, mechanically plausible objects and an unambiguous walking space; every meaning-bearing object must remain fully visible at phone size.
Color palette: black, white, and restrained neutral-gray line hatching only. No cue may depend on color.
Absolute exclusions: no text or pseudo-text; no readable signs or labels; no letters, numbers, arrows, circles, answer marks, logos, brands, watermarks, decorative borders, cropped meaning-bearing objects, impossible joints or poses, duplicated people or parts, floating objects, dramatic spotlighting, or visual emphasis on the target. Do not introduce any unauthored spill, obstruction, damaged cord, sharp object, unstable stack, missing guard, unsafe person, or other hazard.
Output intent: one native raster candidate; do not add annotations or explanatory text.

sourceCatalog.title: 29 CFR 1910.22 General requirements
sourceCatalog.scope: Walking-working surfaces must be kept clean, orderly, sanitary, and free of hazards such as sharp or protruding objects, loose boards, corrosion, leaks, spills, snow, and ice.

sourceCatalog.title: 29 CFR 1910.37 Exit routes
sourceCatalog.scope: Exit routes must be free and unobstructed.

sourceCatalog.title: 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication
sourceCatalog.scope: Workplace containers of hazardous chemicals must be identified; the brief does not infer a chemical identity from appearance.

sourceCatalog.title: FDA Food Code 2022
sourceCatalog.scope: Poisonous or toxic materials must be stored so they cannot contaminate food, equipment, utensils, linens, or single-use articles, including not above them.

sourceCatalog.title: 29 CFR 1910.334 Use of equipment
sourceCatalog.scope: Damaged cord-and-plug equipment must be removed from service; equipment used where water contact is likely must be approved for that location.

sourceCatalog.title: 29 CFR 1910.23 Ladders
sourceCatalog.scope: Ladders must be inspected, used only on stable and level surfaces unless secured or stabilized, and used according to their design.

sourceCatalog.title: NIOSH Ergonomic Guidelines for Manual Material Handling
sourceCatalog.locator: material-handling risk factors and mechanical-aid guidance
sourceCatalog.scope: Use only broad handling, stability, visibility, and mechanical-aid concepts; do not imply one universal lifting technique.

toolCandidates.viewPurpose: Expose the smooth parallel jaws and worm gear in a strict matched comparison view.
mustShow: fixed jaw and movable jaw with smooth parallel gripping faces
clearly visible worm gear beneath the movable jaw
toolCandidates.promptBody:
Primary request: create one generic adjustable wrench in a strict orthographic side profile, handle horizontal and jaws facing left, with the jaws moderately open.
Must show: a fixed jaw and movable jaw with smooth parallel gripping faces; a clearly visible worm gear directly beneath the movable jaw; a complete plain handle; mechanically coherent jaw travel.
Must not show: serrated teeth, an offset hook jaw, a pipe-wrench heel jaw, multiple adjustment channels, or decorative product contours.
Pairing constraint: match the framing, scale, horizontal orientation, and jaw-facing direction requested for candidate v2t002, while preserving the adjustable wrench's own decisive geometry.
toolCandidates.requestedDimensions: native built-in square output; measure after generation

mustNotShow: crescent-wrench worm gear directly under a movable jaw
toolCandidates.promptBody:
Primary request: create one generic straight pipe wrench in a strict orthographic side profile, handle horizontal and jaws facing left, with the throat moderately open.
Must show: a clearly offset curved hook jaw; an opposing heel jaw; distinct serrated tooth rows on both gripping surfaces; a visible knurled adjustment nut; a complete heavy straight handle; mechanically coherent jaw geometry.
Must not show: smooth parallel adjustable-wrench jaws, a crescent-wrench worm gear directly under a movable jaw, pliers handles, a closed throat, or decorative product contours.
Pairing constraint: match the framing, scale, horizontal orientation, and jaw-facing direction requested for candidate v2t001, while preserving the pipe wrench's own decisive geometry.

mustShow: low underside three-quarter view into the open mouth

toolCandidates.promptBody:
Primary request: create one generic cup plunger in a low underside three-quarter view. Tilt the complete tool diagonally so the viewer can look into the rubber cup's open mouth while the full handle remains visible.
Must show: one simple bell-shaped rubber cup; a continuous uninterrupted open rim; an empty center beneath the handle socket; a complete plain handle.
Must not show: an extended lower flange, inner sleeve, folded toilet flange, accordion bellows, toilet, sink, drain, water, or use context.
Pairing constraint: match the framing, scale, handle tilt, and underside camera angle requested for candidate v2t004.

mustNotShow: flange folded invisibly inside the cup
toolCandidates.promptBody:
Primary request: create one generic flange toilet plunger in a low underside three-quarter view. Tilt the complete tool diagonally so the viewer can see beneath the outer rubber cup while the full handle remains visible.
Must show: one outer bell-shaped rubber cup; a distinct narrower cylindrical rubber flange or sleeve extending well below the center of that cup; a clear visible gap and shape transition between the outer cup rim and the lower flange; a complete plain handle.

toolCandidates.viewPurpose: Expose the simple two-position slip pivot without perspective hiding the joint.
mustShow: one simple elongated two-position slip-joint slot
toolCandidates.promptBody:
Primary request: create one generic pair of slip-joint pliers in a strict top-down face view, jaws facing left and handles moderately open.
Must show: one simple elongated pivot slot with exactly two usable pivot positions; the pivot pin visibly seated in one position; ordinary opposing serrated gripping jaws; two complete handles.
Must not show: multiple arcing adjustment channels, a tongue-and-groove rack, long needle-nose jaws, diagonal cutting edges, locking linkage, or pipe-wrench jaws.
Pairing constraint: match the framing, scale, orientation, handle opening, and jaw-facing direction requested for candidate v2t006.

sceneCandidates.claim: A workplace container holding a transferred chemical must be identified.

targets.condition: plain secondary spray bottle visibly holding liquid with a wholly blank body and no identification panel
targets.correction: identify the working container according to the hazard-communication program

decoys.condition: closed generic supply jugs upright in low containment trays with clear nonreadable identification panels
decoys.safeBecause: they are closed, upright, contained, and visually distinguished from the wholly blank secondary bottle

requiredCues: horizontal liquid level visible inside the secondary bottle
other containers closed, stable, and visibly identified without readable text
sceneCandidates.unauthoredHazardPolicy: Reject any visible hazard outside the authored chemical target.
sceneCandidates.promptBody:
Primary request: create a wide landscape custodial closet from an original eye-level composition. On a middle shelf, place one transparent-outline trigger spray bottle visibly half-filled with liquid, using a clear horizontal liquid line and sparse hatching below it. The entire smooth bottle body must be blank: no panel, symbol, writing, or mark. On a separate lower shelf, show several closed generic supply jugs standing upright in low containment trays; each jug has one large bordered identification panel filled only with uniform diagonal hatching, never letters or symbols. A mop is clipped securely into a wall rack, the service sink is empty, the doorway is clear, and the floor is completely dry.
Meaning constraint: the blank half-filled spray bottle is the only hazard. Keep all other containers closed, stable, and contained.
sceneCandidates.requestedDimensions: native built-in wide landscape output; measure after generation

sceneCandidates.promptBody:
Primary request: create a wide landscape school-kitchen storage area from an original straight-on composition. On one stable open metal shelving unit, place several closed generic cleaning-supply bottles on the upper shelf. Give each bottle one large bordered identification panel filled only with uniform diagonal hatching, never letters or symbols. Directly beneath those bottles, on the next shelf in the same vertical column, place uncovered clean mixing bowls and food-preparation utensils. On a clearly separate rack several feet away, store clean pans inverted. Keep the tiled wall clean, the floor dry, and every shelf stable.
Meaning constraint: the only hazard is the chemical-storage relationship directly above the uncovered bowls and utensils. No bottle is open or leaking.

sceneCandidates.promptBody:
Primary request: create a wide landscape orderly school classroom with zero hazards from an original corner viewpoint. Keep a broad, completely dry central aisle unobstructed from foreground to the clear doorway at far left. Against the far-right side wall, well separated from the doorway, place a fully open stepladder with all four feet flat and both spreaders visibly locked; no person is present. Along that same wall edge, place an undamaged cord fully beneath a low-profile cord protector that never enters the aisle. A portable fan on a low cabinet has complete close-spaced front and rear guards. Desks are orderly, chairs tucked in, and a supply cabinet is closed.
Meaning constraint: every suspicious detail is safe as depicted. This scene has zero hazards.

sceneCandidates.promptBody:
Primary request: create a wide landscape gym-side walking lane beside a school gym. A wheeled wet/dry vacuum is parked fully against the side wall, stable and outside the lane. sceneCandidates.promptBody:
Primary request: create a wide landscape school gym wall area. In the foreground against the wall, place one portable floor fan with complete close-spaced front and rear guards. Its cord follows a short route tight along the wall to a receptacle and never enters the walking lane. Near the point where the cord exits the fan housing, show a large split in the outer jacket with two inner insulated conductors clearly visible, while the plug remains connected. No bare copper, sparks, or smoke. Folded mats are stacked flat on a low rack. The floor is dry and the route clear.
Meaning constraint: the damaged cord is the only hazard; the fan guard is complete and safe as depicted.
